items.question: Can I keep meetups small and choose who comes?
items.answer: Yes. Turn on applications, ask your questions and approve each person.

items.question: Can my followers become paying members?
items.answer: Yes. Make a plan with a monthly or yearly price; members renew by UPI Autopay or card.

items.question: Will I know which post worked?
items.answer: Yes. Make a link for each post or collab and see the visits, bookings and revenue from each.

items.question: Do guests need an app?
items.answer: No. They book and pay in their phone’s browser.

items.question: Can a brand sponsor my meetup?
items.answer: Yes. Give the brand its own link to share, and show them the bookings it brought. See {{brand.name}} for brands.

items.question: Can I import my list?
items.answer: Yes. Import a CSV or Excel file of past guests.
